description: Find news articles about companies, brands, people, or topics from Google News. Give queries (1 to 50 search terms; quotes for an exact phrase) and optionally since_days, country, language, only_new, and state_key. Returns one row per article: title, outlet, outlet_domain, published_at, publisher_url and publisher_domain (the article on the publisher's own site), google_url, sentiment (headline only), is_new, and matched_queries. With only_new true, articles returned by an earlier call with the same state_key are skipped and not charged. When no article is returned, one free summary row says why. A run that does not succeed is returned as an error with its run ID. Read-only; requires an APIFY_TOKEN; Apify charges per article returned plus a run start fee.

country.description: Google News country edition. Default US.

exclude_terms.description: Up to 20 words to leave out of every search.

language.description: Language code of the edition, for example en, de, or pt-419. Default en.

max_articles.description: Most articles per search term, 1 to 100, newest first. Default 50.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional cap on this run's cost in USD.

only_new.description: true (default): skip articles an earlier run with the same state_key returned.

queries.description: 1 to 50 search terms: company names, brands, people, or topics. Put a phrase in double quotes for an exact match.

resolve_publisher_url.description: true (default): resolve each article to the publisher's own URL.

state_key.description: Name for this watch list, for example acme-weekly.

name: monitor_news_mentions
title: Monitor news mentions
